title: Autonomous Research Civilization Simulator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Simulates networks of researchers, laboratories, inventions, and resource constraints to explore alternative scientific futures. A proposed simulation environment that models whole research civilizations: researchers with specialties, laboratories with equipment and budgets, the flow of ideas into inventions, and hard resource constraints. It runs alternative histories of science — what if funding shifted, what if a field opened a decade earlier — so planners can explore the consequences of science-policy choices before committing real resources.
capabilities: Model networks of researchers, labs, and institutions
Simulate invention flows under resource constraints
Run counterfactual science-policy scenarios
Identify leverage points where small funding shifts change outcomes
Compare simulated futures against historical science data
